name: helpdesk-copilot-evals-demo
description: Live demo: evaluating an HR & IT Helpdesk RAG + tool-calling agent with promptfoo. Six labs, each pitting a 'buggy' build against a 'fixed' build side by side.

scripts.//: Every lab script runs one promptfoo config. Each config evaluates the buggy and the fixed agent side by side, so 'npm run view' shows red vs green columns.
scripts.all-labs: npm run lab1 && npm run lab2 && npm run lab3 && npm run lab4 && npm run lab5 && npm run lab6
scripts.validate: promptfoo validate -c evals/lab1_retrieval/promptfooconfig.yaml && promptfoo validate -c evals/lab2_faithfulness/promptfooconfig.yaml && promptfoo validate -c evals/lab3_tool_calling/promptfooconfig.yaml && promptfoo validate -c evals/lab4_security/promptfooconfig.yaml && promptfoo validate -c evals/lab5_multi_turn/promptfooconfig.yaml && promptfoo validate -c evals/lab6_model_comparison/promptfooconfig.yaml
